subject: Redact user data when hide-user-data-from-log enabled (#2274)
reason: The change only alters the text of a serverPanic log message in moduleRDBLoadError: it substitutes '*redacted*' for the raw key name when hide-user-data-from-log is set. This is a log-redaction-only change with no effect on command replies, stored data, replication, or persistence. The fuzzer's oracles (liveness, ledger, deployment-state) and the compared-sequence/tools experiments observe crashes, data, replies, and tool output — none of them inspect server log contents — so there is no observable difference between the two builds to drive or assert on, and no meaningful scenario can be writt
